answer: Cloning destroys influence rather than merely delaying admission: forge clusters each operator’s keys across wallet rotation, and prism attests one judged-work epoch per cluster per epoch. opal sets influence to squared uninterrupted tenure, with 100 required per key to trade. Each admission zeroes all cluster tenure; another waits until every key requalifies. The kth admission thus imposes \(10k\) sequential epochs, so ten identities consume 550, versus 10 for a lone newcomer.
